name: sizzle-squad-roblox
description: Roblox port of Sizzle Squad — compiles the web game's domain sim + bots to Luau via TypeScriptToLua

scripts.build: npm run sync && tstl && rojo build -o SizzleSquad.rbxl
scripts.parity: node tools/parity-ts.mjs && lune run tools/parity.luau && node tools/parity-compare.mjs
scripts.publish:staging: npm run build && ROBLOX_PLACE_ID=$SIZZLE_STAGING_PLACE_ID node tools/publish-place.mjs
